STP.note: Links the electoral roll to the civil register, not the civil register to an ID system.
Describes a computerised birth and death register and an ID card campaign; no number given at birth.

facts.fact: The PReSE coordinator says São Tomé and Príncipe has a completely computerised information system of birth and death records.
facts.system: sistema de informação de registos de nascimento e óbito

facts.fact: The PReSE coordinator says the computerised civil-registry system covers deaths as well as births.

facts.fact: A platform for automatic and permanent voter registration is being developed under the EU-funded PReSE with the Universidade de Aveiro, and the electoral database is being consolidated, per the project coordinator.
facts.system: sistema de recenseamento automático e permanente

facts.fact: A campaign is under way to consolidate the electoral registration database using interoperability with the civil registry databases, says the PReSE coordinator.
facts.system: sistema de recenseamento automático e permanente

systems.system: sistema de recenseamento automático e permanente
